title: Brain Knowledge Hub Notebook Metadata Standard
description: Companion metadata configuration for standalone study notebooks in Brain Knowledge Hub

title.description: Human-readable title of the study notebook

description.description: Comprehensive 1-2 sentence executive summary of scope and learning objectives

category.description: Sub-domain or course category (e.g. 'Enterprise Systems', 'Deep Learning', 'Supply Chain')

slug.description: Strictly lowercase, URL-safe slug without spaces (e.g. 'erp', 'transformers-deep-dive')

tags.description: Key topical tags for discovery and search indexing

status.description: Publication status. Set to 'draft' to exclude from public builds.

version.description: Semantic versioning of the study notebook

updated.description: ISO date string of last revision (YYYY-MM-DD)

updatedAt.description: Alternative date field for backwards compatibility (YYYY-MM-DD)

featured.description: Spotlight on portal homepage if true

file.description: Exact filename of the companion HTML notebook

readTimeMinutes.description: Estimated reading and study time in minutes

questionsCount.description: Number of core questions or modules covered
